rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Republic in exercise of the office of President
rows.text: Law No. 8.471 of 7 October 1992, on the composition of the Sixth Region Labour Court, is sanctioned by 'O VICE-PRESIDENTE DA REPÚBLICA no exercício do cargo de PRESIDENTE DA REPÚBLICA', dated Brasília 7 October 1992 and signed Itamar Franco (countersigned Maurício Corrêa); the page notes publication in the DOU of 8 October 1992.
